messages:
sylvia: Heads-up: PR #4602 needs docs sign-off before merge. Adds changelog entry for model-nebula deprecation, a migration note covering param rename (response_mode -> output_mode), updated python/js snippets, and an ops note about kv-cache eviction for very long contexts.

raj: scheduling a review now. tagging @tina for examples and @joe for wording/links.

tina: I'll check the snippets. Are we also adding a short sample showing the new output_mode usage for streaming?

sylvia: yes please. add both sync + async python examples and a short JS streaming snippet. Also add a one-line migration callout about kv-cache eviction defaults.

joe: wording nit on the changelog: avoid alarmist phrasing. recommend "scheduled removal on 2026-06-30" and link to migrations anchor. I'll propose exact wording in the PR comment.

sylvia: updated changelog text and added a placeholder anchor reference. Pushed.

ci-bot: Preview built for PR #4602 — status: failed. Error: broken internal link to /docs/migrations#nebula and missing anchor. See /artifacts/4602/build.log

raj: ok I'll add the anchor and fix the link. Also noticed python snippet has 2-space vs 4-space indentation mismatch; will normalize to 4.

raj: fix pushed: added migration anchor, corrected link path, standardized python snippets to 4-space indent, and added the async streaming example Tina requested. cc @tina @joe

tina: thanks, checked snippets. Added a brief note about default kv-cache eviction behavior for contexts > 50k tokens; looks clear.

joe: re-running proofread. Changelog wording approved. One small ask: include a parenthetical recommending quantization profile q4_0 for the smaller replacement model and note expected perf tradeoffs.

sylvia: added the parenthetical and referenced SDK v3.9.0 where output_mode lands.

ci-bot: Preview built for PR #4602 — status: success. Diff summary: +1 migration anchor, +3 example lines, +2 clarification lines in migration guide, -1 ambiguous sentence in changelog.

raj: engineering review: validated model variant compatibility in staging and confirmed fallback routing will trigger to nebula-lite. Approved.

sylvia: merge timing: prefer to merge during low-traffic window on 2026-05-02 02:00 UTC. Plan: merge at 2026-05-02T02:05:00Z with a 10-minute canary. Any objections?

joe: no objections. Please make sure support is alerted for any post-merge escalations.

tina: fine.

eng-bot: Scheduled merge for PR #4602 at 2026-05-02T02:05:00Z by request of @sylvia. Canary window: 2026-05-02T02:05:00Z — 2026-05-02T02:15:00Z.

sylvia: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
